title: 第13章 我怎能窃取师兄之功第14章 林师妹宗主找你
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
目送赵明御剑离去，陆鸣脸上的笑容渐渐收敛，眉头微微蹙起。
他刚才清晰地看到了赵明看到林清瑶后眼中的震惊和疑惑。
显然，赵明是在惊愕林清瑶短短几天就从炼气十重到了筑基六重！
不得不说。
这速度确实太吓人，任谁都会觉得不可思议。
而林清瑶刚才那句全靠陆师兄指点，算是将自己彻底暴露了。
坏了！
陆鸣瞬间意识到了问题的严重性。
赵明回去肯定会把这事禀报给宗主师伯！
宗主师伯一旦问起，以林清瑶的老实孩子性格肯定会把功劳全扣自己头上！
到时候自己怎么解释？
自己一个凡人是怎么指点出一个几天内连破数境的天才的？
最关键的是，万一宗主师伯真信了邪，觉得自己是什么隐藏的绝世高人。
一定会让自己去参加什么宗门大比，或者下山执行什么危险任务。
如果那样，那自己岂不是分分钟露馅，甚至可能把小命都丢掉？
念及于此，陆鸣立刻转身，看向开始认真琢磨拉伸动作的林清瑶。
“师妹，你过来。”
林清瑶见陆鸣神色严肃，连忙停下动作，乖巧的走到他面前：“师兄，怎么了？”
陆鸣深吸一口气，沉声道：“方才赵明师兄对你的修为进展十分惊讶，你也看到了。”
林清瑶点点头：“嗯，赵师兄似乎很意外。”

“岂止是意外！”
陆鸣加重了语气：“几日时间，从炼气十重直达筑基六重，这般进境，别说天衍宗，就是在整个东荒都堪称惊世骇俗！”
陆鸣接着说道：
“师兄有一言，你切记，今后，无论谁问起你修为为何进展如此神速，你都绝不可将师兄牵扯出来！”
“更不可说出是我指点之类的话！
明白吗？”
“啊？”
林清瑶闻言，美眸中顿时充满了困惑，下意识地反驳道：
“可这明明就是师兄的功劳啊，若非师兄赐下灵食法器，清瑶绝无可能有今日之境界！”
“我怎能窃取师兄之功，独揽此誉？”
见林清瑶一副老实孩子做派，陆鸣无奈的叹了口气。
这师妹，还真是好孩子。
但这件事没得商量。
这样说不行，那就忽悠。
念及于此，陆鸣立刻换了一套说辞：
content_en:
Watching Zhao Ming Yujian leave, the smile on Lu Ming's face gradually faded and his brows furrowed slightly.
He just saw clearly the shock and confusion in Zhao Ming's eyes after seeing Lin Qingyao.
Obviously, Zhao Ming was shocked that Lin Qingyao had gone from the tenth level of Qi Refining to the sixth level of Foundation Building in just a few days!
I have to say.
This speed is indeed so terrifying that anyone would find it incredible.
And Lin Qingyao's sentence just now was all based on Senior Brother Lu's guidance, which completely exposed herself.
broken!
Lu Ming instantly realized the seriousness of the problem.
Zhao Ming will definitely report this matter to the sect leader and uncle when he returns!
Once the master and uncle of the sect asked, Lin Qingyao's honest child character would definitely take all the credit on herself!
How will you explain yourself then?
How could I, a mortal, point out a genius who broke through several realms in a few days?
The most important thing is that if the master of the sect really believes in evil and thinks that he is some kind of hidden peerless master.
He will definitely let himself participate in some sect competition, or go down the mountain to perform some dangerous mission.
If that were the case, wouldn't his secret be revealed in a matter of minutes, and he might even lose his life?
Thinking of this, Lu Ming immediately turned around and looked at Lin Qingyao, who was beginning to seriously consider stretching exercises.
"Junior sister, come here."
Seeing Lu Ming's serious expression, Lin Qingyao quickly stopped her movements and walked up to him obediently: "Senior brother, what's wrong?"
Lu Ming took a deep breath and said in a deep voice: "Senior Brother Zhao Ming was very surprised by your progress in cultivation just now, and you saw it too."
Lin Qingyao nodded: "Well, Senior Brother Zhao seems to be surprised."
"It's more than just an accident!"
Lu Ming emphasized his tone: "In just a few days, from the tenth level of Qi Refining to the sixth level of Foundation Establishment, such an advance is shocking in the entire Eastern Wasteland, let alone the Tianyan Sect!"
Lu Ming continued:
"Senior brother has something to say. You must remember that from now on, no matter who asks why your cultivation is progressing so fast, you must never involve senior brother!"
"Don't even say that it was me who gave the instructions!
Do you understand? "
"Huh?"
When Lin Qingyao heard this, her beautiful eyes were suddenly filled with confusion, and she subconsciously retorted:
"But this is obviously the credit of senior brother. If it weren't for the spiritual food weapon given by senior brother, Qingyao would never be where he is today!"
"How can I steal senior brother's merits and monopolize this reputation?"
Seeing Lin Qingyao acting like an honest child, Lu Ming sighed helplessly.
This junior sister is really a good kid.
But this matter is not negotiable.
If you can't say this, then you're just lying.
